description: No key needed. For a situation with booking_flow catalog (such as cbr): its groups and items with code, name, duration_minutes and fixed price (excl. and incl. VAT; null for items priced per hour plus travel). Match what the customer says (a code such as VEE, or a name) to an item and ask the customer to choose when several match. Pass the item code as examCodeId to tolk2go_interpreting_search_availability and as catalog_item_code to tolk2go_interpreting_create_booking; end = start + duration_minutes.
